item.text: {"search_note":"I searched specifically for 2024 evidence on nuclear safety, command-and-control discipline, custody and fuel handling, emergency preparedness, and accident prevention. I did not find reliable 2024 evidence showing Erdoğan or his government relaxed nuclear safeguards, mishandled custody, produced a nuclear accident, or publicly weakened command-and-control discipline in the nuclear sphere. So for this lens, the evidence base is small but mostly positive, and the strongest support comes from civilian nuclear oversight and emergency-preparedness actions, not from any weapons-related command-and-control record.","evidence":[{"title":"Akkuyu Nükleer Güç Santrali inşaatını ziyaret ettik","publisher":"T.C.
